root.label: Ranges, views, and niebloids
root.note: C++20 ranges replace raw iterator pairs with sentinels, lazy views, lifetime checks, and ADL-safe algorithms.

children.label: Iterators and sentinels
children.note: A range pairs begin() with any sentinel type modeling sentinel_for<iterator_t<R>>.

children.label: Decoupled end types
children.note: Sentinels represent termination conditions like null bytes without matching iterator types.

children.label: ref_view vs owning_view
children.note: views::all borrows lvalues via ref_view and moves non-view rvalues into owning_view.

children.label: Lazy views
children.note: Views model movable ranges with O(1) move and destruction, computing elements on demand.

children.label: Const iteration caveat
children.note: filter_view caches begin() internally, so const filter_view does not satisfy range.

children.label: Pass views by value
children.note: Accept views by forwarding reference or value rather than const reference.

children.label: Non-default views
children.note: DR P2325R3 removed default_initializable from std::ranges::view requirements.

children.label: Borrowed ranges and dangling
children.note: Algorithms avoid returning dangling iterators from expiring temporary containers.

children.label: enable_borrowed_range opt-in
children.note: Types like string_view, span, and subrange opt in because iterators outlive the handle.

children.label: std::ranges::dangling
children.note: Non-borrowed rvalues return a compile-checked placeholder that refuses dereferencing.

children.label: CPOs and niebloids
children.note: Function objects replace fragile unqualified ADL calls with predictable lookup rules.

children.label: Customization point objects
children.note: Inline constexpr objects like ranges::begin dispatch cleanly to member or ADL hooks.

children.label: Niebloids inhibit ADL
children.note: Algorithms like ranges::sort block rogue ADL overloads and accept projection arguments.

children.label: Built-in projection parameter
children.note: Niebloid algorithms accept a callable or member pointer projection directly.

children.label: Pipelines and materialization
children.note: Pipe operators compose closures lazily until collected back into an owning container.

children.label: range_adaptor_closure
children.note: C++23 base class lets user adaptors compose seamlessly via operator|.

children.label: std::ranges::to
children.note: C++23 converter materializes lazy pipelines directly into owning containers.

children.label: Nested container conversion
children.note: std::ranges::to recursively constructs nested containers without common_view adapters.
